APPROVE

The extracted `CompareSegment` keeps the original int, string and mixed-case logic, including the `-1`/`1` result for mixed segments, which the caller still returns because it is non-zero. This removes the nested branching from `Compare`'s loop, so its complexity should fall below 15. The private static helper with `object` parameters should not introduce build warnings. I have not built the project or run the tests, and I did not check how `Compare` is declared outside the diff.
